title: Twisted-Convolution Identities in Dimensions Four and Five from Shintani Ray Units: Reproducibility Archive
description: Submission-specific reproducibility archive for the unconditional formal Twisted Convolution Conjecture in dimensions four and five. It contains the manuscript source and PDF, exact PARI/GP and Python certificates, rigorous Arb enclosures, regression tests, and a deterministic self-checksumming archive.
